_comment: Google does not ship one unified cloud MCP server; parity with the other packs is assembled from Google's managed remote endpoints. (1) Developer Knowledge is this pack's vendor documentation server (the Microsoft Learn / AWS Knowledge counterpart): enable the Developer Knowledge API in a project, create an API key restricted to that API, and supply it via the input below. (2) Per-service managed endpoints follow the pattern https://<service>.googleapis.com/mcp (about 60 services, GA; enable per project with 'gcloud beta services mcp enable <service>'); firestore is registered because this pack ships a Firestore repository skill. Cloud Storage has no managed endpoint — the GCS skill works through gsutil/gcloud. (3) For database access beyond the managed endpoints, Google's open-source MCP Toolbox for Databases is the documented local route. Per-service endpoints authenticate with Google OAuth/ADC; a client that cannot attach an ADC bearer token needs a token helper in front of them.

inputs.description: API key for the Google Developer Knowledge API (restrict the key to that API)
